audience: e-commerce teams that ship orders from ShipStation and need order, tracking and rate data

useCases.title: Find orders awaiting shipment
useCases.text: List orders by status, store, date or customer name. Open one order to read its items, addresses and notes.

useCases.title: Track shipments and fulfillments
useCases.text: List the shipments with labels, with their carrier and tracking numbers. List the orders marked shipped by the API or outside ShipStation.

useCases.title: Compare carrier services and rates
useCases.text: List the services and package types of a carrier. Get shipping rate quotes for a parcel. The quotes buy no label.

useCases.title: Create or update an order
useCases.text: Create an order, or update an open order when its order key matches. Pass a stable order key, so a retry does not create a duplicate.

useCases.title: Hold or tag orders
useCases.text: Hold an order until a date, or release it now. Add or remove a tag on an order.
